test_get_symbol_column_names: test get_symbol_column_names to detect string name and category columns in a pandas DataFrame
test_shorten_name: test shorten_name to strip template parameters and arguments from C++ function names
test_get_symbol_column_names_fallback: test get_symbol_column_names fallback to s_name and s_cat columns when primary columns are non-string
test_get_symbol_column_names_no_match: test get_symbol_column_names returns empty strings when no matching name or category columns exist
test_shorten_name_complex: test shorten_name on complex templated C++ kernel names to extract the base function identifier
